# dsh-webui-m3e
日本語 | English | 简体中文

> [!WARNING]
> This project is archived and will receive no further updates. Please use kuraneko1/ds
h-mobile-maxxing instead.
A Material 3 Expressive (M3E) mobile Web UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH), so you can use DSH co
mfortably on a phone.
The screenshots show mock screens. The app UI is shown in Japanese, English, or Simplified Chinese.

> [!NOTE]
> This is a personal project and is not an official DeepSeek product. It is under developm
ent and may contain bugs. Please use it with care.
## Quick Start

> [!IMPORTANT]
> The published release **0.0.9** (GitHub Latest) is built for **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2**. In
stall DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 with `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2` and check it with `dsh --version`.
**0.0.8 is for DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 only** and does not run on 0.2.1-rc.2. If you stay on DSH 0.2.0-rc.2,
install v0.0.8 instead.
1. Run this on the machine running DSH:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`web` is an example, so select the profile that actually serves your Web UI (a misspelled name still
creates a new profile, and a successful install alone does not confirm the target).
2. Open the sign-in URL printed by `dsh web` to sign in to the standard interface (DSH's own Web UI)
. Open the sign-in URL printed by `dsh web` to sign in to the standard interface (DSH's own Web UI).
3. Open `http://<host>/m3e/` on the same address. If it returns 404, restart that profile's Host. Re
starting the Host (stop `dsh web` with Ctrl+C and start it again with the same command) can change t
he sign-in URL, so repeat from step 2.
M3E is not published to the npm registry, so installing by name with `add dsh-webui-m3e` is unavaila
ble. M3E has no additional runtime packages to install, and you do not need its source, a local buil
d, or its development dependencies. Always restart the Host after an update or rollback, because tha
t switches the Host code between versions.
## Features

> [!NOTE]
> This section describes 0.0.9 and main. 0.0.8 does not have pinning, archived-session dis
play and restore, base color selection, the plugin list, the shared error screens, or the Modes page
ore, base color selection, the plugin list, the shared error screens, or the Modes page in Settings.
- **Conversations:** Read AI responses, tool results, and reasoning at phone width. You can also swi

tch to a chronological trace view (「トレース」 in the app).
- **Session list:** Pin conversations to the
top of the list. Pins are shared across all workspaces, and changes made in the standard interface o
r on other devices are reflected too. You can show archived conversations by switching the list filt

er, and restore one from the long-press menu.
- **Responses:** Approve tools, answer AI questions, a

nd review plans from a bottom sheet, whatever screen you are on.
- **Inbox:** See conversations that

need a response together with completed conversations.
- **Composer:** Attach images, reference fil
es with `@`, get command suggestions with `/`, and switch models, reasoning effort, permission prese

ts, and plan mode.
- **Session tools:** Open stats, files, jobs, subagents, and goals from the conve

rsation menu.
- **Search:** Search conversations.
- **Settings:** Manage DSH settings, API keys, and
custom providers. The Modes page (「モード」 in the app) lists the agent presets and lets you pick the o

ne used for new conversations.
- **Workspaces:** Switch workspaces from the drawer in the session li

st.
- **Appearance:** Besides light and dark, choose the base color on each device from six presets
(purple, blue, teal, green, orange, red) or any color. The chosen color is applied to the whole inte

rface.
- **Plugins:** From Settings, check the state of installed plugins in a read-only list.
- **E
rrors:** A shared screen explains the cause and the next action for render failures, unknown screens

, conversations that fail to open, and being offline at startup.
- **Home screen:** On iPhone, choos
e "Add to Home Screen" in Safari to open it like an app. Behavior as a Web app added to the Home Scr
een is not verified.
The existing DSH interface remains available. You can choose which interface to use on each device.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.1-rc.2** (published 0.0.9 and this repository's main)
- Use 0.0.9 with this

version. See Quick Start for installation. Support for the 0.1.5 series has been removed.
- See doc

s/dsh-compatibility.md (Japanese) for results, known differences, and unverified paths.
- Install DS
H itself with an explicit version. npm dist-tags such as `latest` and `next` move over time (on 2026
-10-20 both pointed to 0.2.1-rc.2), so pin the version that this repository supports.
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Check your installed version with `dsh --version`.
- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.0-rc.2** (when using 0.0

.8)
- Use v0.0.8 with this version. 0.0.9 does not run on 0.2.0-rc.2.
- Node.js that meets DSH's and

pnpm's requirements, and pnpm on PATH (used by the regular npm-installed DSH CLI).
- DSH itself dec
lares no minimum Node version, but its CLI dependency commander 15 requires Node `>=22.12.0`, and pn
pm 11.17.0 requires `>=22.13`. Use Node that meets both DSH's and your pnpm version's requirements.
- The tested environment is macOS 27.2, Node.js 26.7.0 and pnpm 11.17.0; those dependency declaratio

ns do not establish M3E's minimum supported Node version.
- The DSH Desktop app has not been verifie
d for this release in this environment. There is an upstream bundled-pnpm path, but keep it separate
from the regular CLI results.
## Usage
Installation, signing in to the standard interface, and opening `http://<host>/m3e/` are covered in
, signing in to the standard interface, and opening `http://<host>/m3e/` are covered in Quick Start.
On iPhone, choose "Add to Home Screen" from Safari's Share menu to open it like an app. On a real de
vice, only opening it in Safari has been confirmed; behavior as a Web app added to the Home Screen i
ing it in Safari has been confirmed; behavior as a Web app added to the Home Screen is not verified.
### Switching interfaces
In this README, the "standard interface" is DSH's own Web UI (the URL parameter and the setting call
it "classic"). Choose which interface to use on this device with any of the following options. Your
choice is saved separately on each device.
- In the standard interface: `Settings → General → Use the M3E interface on this device` (the row fo

llows the standard interface's language)
